title: Edifício Copan
visualBrief: Individually mapped S-shaped Copan with three brise blades per floor, separate glazed and perforated rear facades, real cobogo openings, open helical stair flights, a rounded lift tower, framed retail glazing, shared mosaic and separately assembled roof platform. Repeated details share GPU-instanced geometry.

assembly.method: Reusable named mesh parts with glTF node transforms; shared materials, no duplicated bitmap library.

nativeAxes.front: Principal brise face follows the signed native map outline indices 0–64; +Y is up
nativeAxes.origin: Centre of mapped exact-QID ground envelope; ground contact is provisional

scaleBasis: Exact-QID map footprint for horizontal envelope; IBGE 115 m and 32 residential storeys for overall stack. Detailed floor/roof datums, brises, openings and podium are reconstructed and require dimensioned as-built evidence.

appearance.state: Architectural facade reconstruction without temporary restoration netting
appearance.basis: Primary conservation study and contractor photographs; not a claim that restoration has finished or that all tenant alterations have been surveyed.

geographicProposal.orientationConfidence: municipal south-screen statement and raw exact-QID projections
geographicProposal.evidence: Fresh raw Q632566 way 8100248 independently matches the preserved 200-point ground ring within 0.002 m rounding. Anchor [-46.644483918,-23.546584452] and heading 0.390775195386 remain fixed; native +X points ENE at 67.61 degrees and +Z SSE at 157.61 degrees. The municipal restoration record independently calls the perforated cobogo facade the south facade. Raw coordinates place rear lift and stair projections on that side, opposite the principal northern brise curve (outline indices 0–64). The conservation plan and contractor photographs confirm the separate glazed rear block, screened rear blocks, one capsule lift tower and three open stair projections. Named southwest/northwest ends in the redrawn conservation plan are not used as compass controls: their reproduced page compass has not been reconciled with the raw site. Base Y0 is approximate local grade; actual street slope remains unsurveyed. Retain 115 m and 32 residential floors from the published IBGE record as the reconstruction basis; mapped 118.44 m and 37 total levels remain separately reported, without a surveyed datum reconciliation. No footprint replacement.
geographicProposal.limitations: Actual street slope, complete commercial podium boundary and signed facade registration have not been approved.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: The original eleven-part GPU-instanced source assembly is preserved byte-for-byte and remains reconstructable from copan-model.mjs. Browser levels use four groups: shared ceramic mosaic, concrete and painted metal plus opaque glass. The principal S-curve, separate southern glass/screen blocks, lift capsule, three stair positions, 32-floor stack and roof platform remain. Near brise blades keep their outer 0.115 m lips with double-sided midplanes rather than hidden inner faces. Close-up retains all three blades per ordinary floor, original open transfer bands and 6 by 4 geometric perforations per panel; street retains blades with a coarser curve and 2 by 1 perforations every other floor; district has coarse eight-floor bands and 1 by 1 screens; skyline replaces dense fins with a closed midpoint facade proxy. Far podiums are closed shells. Near rear gallery glazing closes previously exposed gaps inside the mapped residential envelope; it is an approximate architectural closure, without a surveyed shop inventory. Close-up stairs retain twenty individual flat treads per reconstructed turn with continuous narrow handrail strips and alternate open pickets; the preserved source retains closed individual tread slabs, and precise stair risers, handedness and rail inventory remain unsurveyed. Street uses eight segments and district four; skyline uses small capped stair proxies whose external half-width remains within the one metre envelope allowance. All curves are deterministic adaptive polylines. Source white/gray ceramic finishes are the intended architecture, without temporary protection netting or a claim that restoration is complete. The modeled gallery follows the mapped residential envelope; the wider executed cinema/commercial site, neighboring bank and curved corner terraces require a separate site model and are excluded from this residential-block asset. Floor levels, transfer bands, screen dimensions, roof equipment and doors are reconstructions, not measured as-built details. Published height/level and plan-scale differences remain explicit. Flat grade is approximate. Physical phone/laptop and dense-city timings remain pending.
